result.title: EntroPrefill: Renyi-Guided Context Pruning with Conditional Stability Guarantees for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
result.comment: 16 pages, 0 figures. Theoretical framework and conditional stability guarantees for context pruning; no empirical evaluation or benchmarks are included
result.summary: Mid-prefill pruning can reduce the sequence processed by deeper transformer layers, but attention concentration alone does not certify that discarded context is dispensable. We formulate EntroPrefill as a Renyi-guided proposal mechanism coupled to explicit constraints on discarded attention mass. Sink-isolated, regularized head pooling respects grouped-query attention while exposing a quantitative trade-off between specialization and worst-head coverage. We derive a mixture-to-head deletion envelope, a computable upper bound on feasible token removal, and a finite-sample observer guarantee that remains valid when the pruning layer is selected adaptively. We then establish a conditional transformer perturbation bound with explicit sufficient Lipschitz constants and a first-token decision-margin corollary. A counterexample shows why shallow observations alone cannot imply an unconditional future-output guarantee. The systems analysis distinguishes query-head unions, physical page allocation, and KV-transfer payload, and gives an arithmetic break-even condition for pruning. This manuscript is theoretical in scope: it defines the procedure, its assumptions, and its formal limits, but does not report measured acceleration or task-accuracy preservation. Experiments are reserved for subsequent validation of the assumptions, approximation tightness, and end-to-end resource trade-offs.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 EntroPrefill，一种基于 Renyi 熵引导的 prefill 阶段上下文剪枝框架，用被丢弃注意力质量约束、混合到头的删除包络和条件 Lipschitz 扰动界来刻画剪枝的可证稳定性，属理论工作，未报告加速或精度实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的关联在于「视觉证据筛选」与 STOP/计算成本：其基于注意力质量与熵的丢弃准则、以及浅层观测不足以保证未来输出的反例，可供核查 latent 状态中视觉 token 何时可安全丢弃、剪枝是否切断证据通路。
